summary: Xcel Energy filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for an at-the-market common stock program of up to $6.0 billion, replacing a prior equity distribution agreement dated May 2026 that had roughly $448.6 million unsold. About $3.8 billion of forward sale agreements from the prior program and $2.2 billion from an August 2025 program remain outstanding. Sales agents may act as principals or forward sellers, with forward purchasers borrowing shares to hedge; proceeds arrive only on physical settlement. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch share overhang and forward settlement dilution.
